subject: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Hi Alex -

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the performance / SLO items we discussed and lay out the proposed next steps (MAP) so we can get the pilot scheduled. TL;DR: attached SLO checklist + demo recording, please review and confirm the targets below.

SLO checklist (proposed):
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for single-turn generation (non-streaming). For streaming, token latency (server-to-client chunk) <= 50ms.
- Throughput: sustained 500 req/s with headroom for 1.0k req/s bursts.
- Concurrency: support 200 concurrent user sessions (we'll define session semantics in the pilot).
- Streaming: incremental token streaming required for chat UI - partial responses must start within 150ms of first token generation.
- Context length: 8k token support to start; can increase for later phases.
- Availability: 99.9% uptime during pilot window.

What we will provide for the pilot:
- A short 48-hour performance pilot environment (dedicated pool) with the above targets.
- Test harness and sample traffic script for reproducing your workload.
- SLO dashboard access (latency/throughput/concurrency breakdowns).
- Recording of the demo attached.

Next steps / mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Confirm final SLO targets (latency/concurrency/streaming) - you
2) Share any corp procurement milestones & security questionnaire items - FintechCo
3) We provision the pilot and send the test harness - Redwood (Nikhil)
4) Pilot kickoff & 48hr run - target week of Oct 18
5) Review results and commercial terms - both teams

Attachments: FintechCo_SLO_Checklist_v1.pdf, redwood-demo-recording.mp4

Could you confirm the targets above (especially the p95 and concurrency) and whether the week of Oct 18 works for a 48-hour pilot? Happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff next week.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
This email and attachments are intended for the named recipients only.
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>, Erin Moore <erin.moore@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-10-11 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and for the attachments - very helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side after syncing with the infra and product teams:

- Latency: we actually need p95 <= 200ms for interactive single-turn responses to meet our UX bar. Is that reachable in the pilot with the dedicated pool you mentioned?
- Concurrency: our realistic peak concurrency (webSocket sessions rendering streaming tokens) is closer to 300-350 active sessions. Can we size the pilot to validate up to 350 concurrent sessions?
- Throughput: 1k req/s bursts sounds right; sustained may be closer to 600 req/s.
- Streaming: streaming with chunked responses is mandatory. We'll render partial turns as they arrive; token-level latency matters less than chunk latency (aim for sub-100ms chunk delivery).
- Context length: 8k is fine to start. We'll provide a sample dataset for the test harness.

Also, can you confirm which model variant we'll run in the pilot (baseline vs quantized variant) and whether KV cache/prefix caching will be enabled? Lastly, procurement would like a rough cost estimate for the 48-hour pilot environment to budget internally.

On Oct 18 works in principle but we need the kickoff earlier in the week if possible so procurement can sign any short-term agreement. Can we aim for Oct 16 or 17?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Erin Moore <erin.moore@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-10-11 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Alex -

Appreciate the quick follow-up and helpful detail. We can absolutely adjust the pilot to the updated targets you called out. Confirmations and notes below:

- Latency: we will aim for p95 <= 200ms for single-turn responses in the pilot. To hit that consistently we will use a higher-capacity Dedicated pool and the low-latency model variant.
- Concurrency: pilot will be sized to validate up to 350 concurrent sessions. We'll provide a traffic pattern that ramps to 350 and holds for validation windows.
- Throughput: we'll plan for sustained 600 req/s with validated bursts to 1k req/s.
- Streaming: enabled - we'll configure chunked streaming with target chunk delivery < 100ms. We'll also enable prefix/KV caching where applicable to reduce repeated context cost.
- Model variant: we'll run the low-latency quantized variant (redwood-lowlat-1.2q) for the pilot; if you prefer a different model we can swap.

Updated MAP + dates:
- Draft pilot start: Oct 18, 2026 (48 hours).
- Proposed kickoff meeting: Oct 17, 2026 10:00 AM PT (30 minutes) - to align test harness, success criteria, and procurement items.
- Owner: Redwood (Nikhil) will provision the environment and share access + dashboard.

Attachments: FintechCo_SLO_Checklist_v2.xlsx (updated targets), MAP_Roadmap_Oct2026.pdf (outline & success criteria).

Cost estimate for 48-hour pilot: we'll follow up with a one-line estimate before kickoff; ballpark for the configured Dedicated pool is ~$6k- $9k for the 48-hour run depending on burst usage (exact numbers and a line-item estimate will come from finance).

If Oct 17 at 10:00 AM PT works, I'll send a calendar invite and Nikhil will share the traffic scripts this week.

Thanks - and looping in Nikhil and Laura to action provisioning.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
